facts.claim: MSC Lirica (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2003; 65,591 GT; 1984 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Lirica class.
MSC Lirica is the lead ship in her class of cruise ship, owned and operated by MSC Cruises.
MSC Opera is an identical sister ship to the MSC Lirica.

catalogSpecs.description: Lirica-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2003; 65,591 GT; approx. 1,984 guests at double occupancy.
